description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, broken down by researcher location categories shown in the legend. The horizontal axis lists the categories as years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order, labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at approximately 10^0, 10^1, and 10^2 (covering roughly 1 to 100+ datasets). For each year, multiple narrow, side-by-side colored bars represent locations: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown), with no stacking; the bars are not sorted by height within each year. Approximate values by year include: 2012 shows USA at about 2; 2013 shows USA at about 2; 2014 shows Other about 2 and USA about 1; 2015 shows Other about 3 and DE about 1; 2016 shows USA about 7, Other about 4, IN about 3, and UK about 2; 2017 shows Other about 18, USA about 14, UK about 9, IT about 5, IN about 1, and DE near 1; 2018 shows Other about 30, USA about 12, and IN/UK/IT/DE each around 4; 2019 shows Other about 50, USA about 16, IT about 8, IN about 6, and UK about 2; 2020 shows Other about 90, USA about 40, DE about 18, UK about 15, IN about 12, and IT about 2; 2021 shows Other slightly above 100, USA about 45, IN about 25, UK about 18, IT about 12, and DE about 9; 2022 shows a set of lighter-tinted bars with approximate values around Other ~25, IN ~9, UK ~8, USA ~3, and IT ~1 (with no clearly visible DE bar). No bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend titled “Researcher Location.”
